result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from every promotion listing and from the lookup by code. The full offline suite passes (608 tests, BUILD SUCCESS). Nothing is committed.

What changed:
- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`. The database is built fresh from this file, so no migration is needed.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. It is null when a promotion has none.
- **`PromotionStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and the shared select that every promotion query uses now includes it.
- **`Rows.java`**: the row mapper reads the description.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. The existing 5-argument version stays and passes `null`, so the existing callers and tests did not need edits. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category is.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: one new test. It creates a promotion with the description and one without, then checks the text comes back from the category listing, the date listing and the region listing, and that the one without is null.

Not covered by the new test: the best-promotion, unused-promotions and code-lookup paths. They use the same select and row mapper, so they get the description too, but I did not assert on them directly.
